title: Mehdi and Owen on Their Russell Brand Interviews
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:

Both **Mehdi** and **Owen** have been attacked by the right over their
previous interviews with [convicted ](https://abcnews.com/GMA/Culture/russell-
brand-faces-sentencing-after-guilty-verdict-rape/story?id=137914316)rapist,
Russell Brand, more than ten years ago - when he had been charged with no
crimes. Now, they hit back at their critics, reflecting on the backlash and
dissecting the hypocrisy of the British legacy media.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Plus, Mehdi wants to rejoin the EU - Owen doesn't agree. Listen to their
arguments, including Mehdi**** agreeing with Margaret Thatcher of all people
on the narrow issue that** "referendums are the devices of demagogues"** - do
let us know whose side you're on in the comments below!

And, during a discussion about current restrictions on free speech in the U.S.
and UK (and wonder what happened to the 'cancel culture' warriors of a few
years ago), Owen reveals why he believes a school's referral of four East-
London children to a counter-terrorism group for [wearing
](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/nov/20/lion-academy-trust-children-
palestine-badges-prevent-london)Palestinian badges to school **" is the
biggest assault on free speech."**
